actions.name: Use
actions.area: 20-ft.-radius emanation centered on a touched object

description.summary: Upon the casting of this spell, complete silence prevails in the affected area of the object.
description.value: Upon the casting of this spell, complete silence prevails in the affected area of the object. All sound is stopped: Conversation is impossible, spells with verbal components cannot be cast, and no noise whatsoever issues from, enters, or passes through the area. Creatures in an area of a silence object spell are immune to sonic or language-based attacks, spells, and effects.
